title: CMS
description: packages.cms: the sites of the project and how they are reached on this installation.

siteAddress.title: Site addresses
siteAddress.description: How the sites of the project answer here, a regular expression with {site} (the name of the site) or {name} (its name without the TLD). A path starts with /: /projects(\.[a-z]+)?/{site}/. A host: {name}.systopic.net. One without a placeholder is the address of the default site. Several, separated by commas. Empty: every site on its own domain and aliases, as on LIVE.

access.title: Access
access.description: Who sees the website and what an editor gets on it.

public.title: Public
public.description: Off: only signed-in visitors see the website.

pagePermissions.title: Page permissions
pagePermissions.description: Pages can be limited to groups of visitors (Pages, Permissions).

editBar.title: Edit bar
editBar.description: The bar of the CMS on the website for signed-in editors.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: The defaults of the meta tags. A site and a page can have their own.

robots.title: Robots
robots.description: What search engines may do: index, follow.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The languages of the website. A new one is added on every installation; where the database has no content in it yet, its pages are empty.

default.title: Default language
default.description: The language of a page that names none.

autoDetect.title: Detect the language
autoDetect.description: The home page opens in the language of the browser.

propertyNames.description: The language code: de, en, fr …
